title: Ardisiaoside A, a new triterpenoid glycoside from Ardisia gigantifolia, induces cell senescence and targets cancer stem cells in gastric cancer.
authors: Pham, Van Khang; Le, Thi Thanh Huong; Hua, Nguyet Mai; Pham, Son Hiep; Hoang, Van Hung; Nguyen, Thi Kieu Oanh; Nguyen, Phu Hung
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Ardisiaoside A对胃癌干细胞的作用，仅用分子对接初步探测与蛋白的相互作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study aimed to isolate bioactive constituents from Ardisia gigantifolia and assess their effects on gastric cancer stem cells (CSCs) properties. Cytotoxicity and proliferation were quantified using the MTT assay; cell-cycle distribution, CD44 expression, and apoptosis/senescence markers were evaluated by flow cytometry and beta-galactosidase staining; reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation and tumorsphere formation were analyzed by fluorescence microscopy and 3D culture; gene expression was measured by qPCR; molecular docking probed interactions with CSCs markers and Notch signaling proteins. Four compounds were isolated, including Ardisiaoside A, beta-sitosterol, and two long-chain n-alcohols (octacosan-1-ol, nonacosan-1-ol). Ardisiaoside A was reported from this species for the first time and showed the greatest potency, reducing viability at low micromolar doses (IC(50): 1.08 +/- 0.37 microM in AGS, 2.50 +/- 0.72 microM in MKN45 cells). It suppressed migration, induced G2/M arrest, and triggered senescence. CD44 surface levels was markedly reduced, and tumorsphere number and size were inhibited at 2.5 microM. qPCR and immunofluorescence demonstrated notable downregulation of stemness-related genes (OCT4, NANOG) and Notch pathway components, consistent with reduced self-renewal. Molecular docking supported the binding of Ardisiaoside A to NANOG, OCT4, CD44, and Notch proteins (NOTCH1, HES1, DLL1, DLL4), consistent with target inhibition. In conclusion, Ardisiaoside A, a newly identified triterpenoid glycoside from Ardisia gigantifolia, represents a promising candidate that inhibits cell proliferation by reducing cancer stem-cell populations and inducing cellular senescence in gastric cancer.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在从大叶紫金牛（Ardisia gigantifolia）中分离生物活性成分，并评估其对胃癌干细胞（CSCs）特性的影响。采用MTT法量化细胞毒性和增殖；通过流式细胞术和β-半乳糖苷酶染色评估细胞周期分布、CD44表达及凋亡/衰老标志物；通过荧光显微镜和3D培养分析活性氧（ROS）生成和肿瘤球形成；通过qPCR测量基因表达；分子对接探讨了与CSCs标志物及Notch信号蛋白的相互作用。共分离出四种化合物，包括Ardisiaoside A、β-谷甾醇及两种长链正醇（二十八烷-1-醇、二十九烷-1-醇）。Ardisiaoside A系首次从该物种中报道，且显示出最强效力，在低微摩尔剂量下降低细胞活力（AGS细胞中IC(50)：1.08 +/- 0.37 微摩尔，MKN45细胞中2.50 +/- 0.72 微摩尔）。它抑制迁移、诱导G2/M期阻滞并触发衰老。在2.5 微摩尔浓度下，CD44表面水平显著降低，肿瘤球数量和大小受到抑制。qPCR和免疫荧光显示干性相关基因（OCT4、NANOG）及Notch通路成分显著下调，与自我更新能力降低一致。分子对接支持Ardisiaoside A与NANOG、OCT4、CD44及Notch蛋白（NOTCH1、HES1、DLL1、DLL4）的结合，与靶点抑制相符。总之，Ardisiaoside A是从大叶紫金牛中新发现的三萜糖苷，通过减少癌症干细胞群体并诱导胃癌细胞衰老来抑制细胞增殖，是一个有前景的候选化合物。
